query: SELECT a.seq, a.no_tran, b.tgl_tran, b.no_memo, b.kode_cabang, b.kode_gudang, b.kode_jenis_terima, a.kode_barang, a.qty_terima, a.hrg_pokok, a.input_by, a.input_dt, a.update_by, a.update_dt, a.catatan FROM sch_erp_inventory.trd_penerimaan_lain a LEFT JOIN sch_erp_inventory.trh_penerimaan_lain b ON a.no_tran = b.no_tran
